newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica govt financing 3.83 billion rand in August.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica govt financing 3.83 billion rand in August.

text.p: South Africa's Department of Finance said total financing in August amounted to 3.827 billion rand, bringing total financing from April to August to 20.228 billion.
Provisional figures showed 3.812 billion rand was obtained in government stock in August, while short-term loans (net) increased by 15 million rand.
Budgeted financing for the current fiscal year (April-March) is 45.105 billion rand. This figure includes provision for foreign loans of 2.5 billion rand.
The department said government bonds and debentures to the amount of 8.120 billion rand were redeemed during April to August 1996.
